_comment: LuV coated conductor line (gtceu:coated_conductor_line, type gtceu:coated_conductor; docs/eras/luv.md, machine 2; package LuV-A3).

server_scripts/grindless/luv/coated_conductor_line.js makes one recipe per entry, id grindless:coated_conductor/<name>; the programmed circuit is the step (1 substrate, 2 tape) and each recipe carries the data key grindless_coated_conductor = <name> (its EMI line).

Substrate: Ni-5at.%W (19 Ni + 1 W), rolled and annealed to a cube texture (RABiTS). Tape: a micron-thick ITBTC film on it, oxygen-annealed, with a silver cap layer: an eighth of a cast single wire's superconductor per tape.
Figures marked tune in luv.md: both EU/t x durations and the tape's ITBTC share.

recipes.name: gd_123_precursor
recipes._why: UIV-A8, line 23: gadolinium oxide and the barium-copper blend fired in oxygen to the Gd-123 phase (GdBa2Cu3O7), the bulk GdBCO's feed.

recipes.name: strand_tape
recipes._why: UXV-A8 (docs/eras/uxv.md, lines 34-37 and 39): pasta strand wire flattened and clad with copper foil as the stabiliser, the coated conductor line's UXV tape (the pump, piston and conveyor coils, the field generator, the SMES cell).

recipes.name: rebco_tape_max
recipes._why: MAX-A2 line L9 (c5): ITBTC coated conductor bonded to horizon strand wire under epoxy, the REBCO tape the MAX field coil is wound from.

recipes.name: rebco_on_pbo_web
recipes._why: MAX-B1 line L2 (c6): ITBTC coated conductor laid on the buffered PBO web under an epoxy bond, the REBCO-on-polymer web the membrane is made from.

recipes.name: smes_buffered_tape
recipes._why: MAX-W (docs/eras/max.md, L27 step 1): ITBTC coated conductor laminated with strand tape under an epoxy bond, the buffered tape the SMES toroid is wound from.

recipes.name: fcl_tape
recipes._why: MAX-A4 line L39 (c8): ITBTC coated conductor laid on the high-resistivity Hastelloy substrate strip under an epoxy bond, the shunt-backed tape of the fault-current limiter.
